faqs.question: Why is website speed so critical for modern businesses?
faqs.answer: Research consistently proves that 53% of mobile visitors abandon a website if it takes longer than 3 seconds to load. Furthermore, Google officially uses Core Web Vitals as a direct organic ranking signal. Faster websites rank higher, engage visitors better, and convert more traffic into revenue.

faqs.question: Can you speed up my existing WordPress site without redesigning it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most speed issues are caused by unoptimised images, render-blocking scripts, dormant plugins, and lack of proper edge caching. We can dramatically improve performance while keeping your current design and content completely intact.

faqs.question: What kind of performance improvements can we expect?
faqs.answer: On clean codebases and modern hosting environments, we regularly achieve sub-second LCP and high 90s mobile performance scores. Where third-party scripts (such as Facebook Pixel or chat widgets) are necessary, we isolate and defer them so real visitors experience instant initial page loads.

faqs.question: Will our website look or function differently after speed optimisation?
faqs.answer: No. Visual styling and user functionality remain identical. The only difference is that elements render instantaneously and interactions respond without lag.
